name: 1031 Exchange Timeline Calculator
meta_description: Find your 1031 exchange deadlines: the 45-day identification date and the 180-day closing date, shortened if your tax return is due first.
subtitle: Enter the closing date of the property you sold to find the 45-day deadline for identifying replacement property and the deadline for closing on it, which is day 180 or your tax return due date if that comes first.
